title: Spray Painting
heading: A Smooth Finish for a Fresh Exterior.
intro: Refresh broad exterior surfaces with professional spray painting. Careful preparation, controlled application and thorough protection help create an even finish suited to your home or commercial property.
explain: An Even Finish Starts with a Controlled Approach.
paragraphs: Spray painting is a practical option for covering larger exterior areas and detailed profiles with a consistent finish. The method is selected around the surface, coating, access and surroundings rather than used as a one-size-fits-all solution.

Overspray control is an important part of the work. We consider nearby windows, landscaping, vehicles and adjoining properties, then plan masking and application around the conditions. Some areas may still need brushing or rolling to complete the finish.
prepare: Clean and prepare the substrate, address loose coating and protect neighbouring surfaces with careful masking.
apply: Apply the selected coating with controlled spray passes; brush or back-roll where the surface and product require it.
condition: Loose paint, dirt, chalking and repairs affect how a sprayed finish adheres. Preparation comes before application.
material: The substrate determines the primer, coating and application method. Spraying is an application technique, not a substitute for surface assessment.
goals: Tell us whether you want a whole exterior refresh or selected walls and features coated together.
tip: Plan access and keep vehicles and movable items clear of the work area.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your exterior surfaces with the rest of the property.
Preparation and products chosen around the material and its condition.
Refresh the agreed areas without assuming every component needs replacement.
scopeDescriptions: Larger siding areas form the main focus of this service. We inspect their condition and discuss the areas you want refreshed.
Textured and profiled surfaces can be included where the material and condition are suitable for the planned finish.
Coordinated trim and accents help coordinate the project with the surrounding exterior features.
Residential and commercial walls are reviewed as part of the agreed scope, access and preparation requirements.

title: Aluminum Painting
heading: A Fresh Look for Your Aluminum Exterior.
intro: Update faded aluminum siding with a clean, coordinated finish. We assess the existing coating, prepare the panels and recommend a painting approach that suits their condition.
explain: Restore the Appearance of the Panels You Already Have.
paragraphs: Aluminum siding can lose its colour and develop chalking as it weathers. Painting can refresh its appearance without replacing sound panels, provided the surface is properly assessed and prepared.

Cleaning and adhesion are central to aluminum painting. We look at the existing finish, exposed metal, dents and joints before selecting the preparation and coating system. Damaged panels or active corrosion may need attention before painting.
prepare: Remove chalking and contamination, address failing coating and assess exposed metal before priming where appropriate.
apply: Apply a coating system suited to prepared aluminum, maintaining an even finish across panel profiles and edges.
condition: Chalking, peeling, dents and exposed metal help determine whether cleaning, repairs or priming are needed.
material: Aluminum panels and adjoining materials may need different preparation and products. We assess each area separately.
goals: Consider whether to repaint every elevation or refresh selected panels alongside trim and other exterior details.
tip: Point out any dents, loose panels or areas where the existing finish has failed.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your aluminum siding with the rest of the property.
Preparation and products chosen around the material and its condition.
Refresh the agreed areas without assuming every component needs replacement.
scopeDescriptions: Aluminum lap siding form the main focus of this service. We inspect their condition and discuss the areas you want refreshed.
Metal panel details can be included where the material and condition are suitable for the planned finish.
Coordinated aluminum trim help coordinate the project with the surrounding exterior features.

title: Siding Painting
heading: That Transforms and Protects.
intro: Refresh the look of your home and extend the life of your exterior with professional siding painting. We provide carefully prepared finishes for a range of siding types, helping you achieve a clean, modern appearance while protecting your property from the elements.
explain: A Fresh Finish for the Exterior You Already Have.
paragraphs: Your home’s siding is constantly exposed to sun, rain, snow and temperature changes. Over time, this can lead to fading, chalking and a worn appearance. A professional siding painting service restores the look of your exterior and helps protect the surface.

We work with a variety of siding materials, including wood, vinyl, aluminum and engineered siding. Each surface has its own characteristics, and our team uses an approach suited to its preparation and painting needs. Whether you’re looking for a subtle refresh or a complete colour change, siding painting can make a difference in how your home looks and feels.
prepare: Clean the siding, address surface issues and prepare the areas to help the new finish look its best and last longer.
apply: Use exterior coatings and application methods selected for your siding type to achieve a smooth, even finish.
condition: We assess existing surfaces, discuss concerns and recommend the approach that suits your home’s condition.
material: Wood, vinyl, aluminum and engineered siding each have different preparation and coating requirements.
goals: Whether you want a subtle refresh or a complete colour change, we consider your vision, property and budget.
tip: Consider how the new colour will work with your roof, trim and surroundings.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your siding with the rest of the property.

title: Vinyl Siding Painting
heading: A New Colour for the Vinyl Siding You Have.
intro: Give your vinyl siding a refreshed appearance with a preparation and coating plan designed for the material. We assess the panels and help you explore suitable colour options before work begins.
explain: Refresh Your Exterior with a Vinyl-Specific Approach.
paragraphs: Painting can update the appearance of sound vinyl siding when the coating and colour are suitable for the material. We inspect the siding, existing finish and exposure before recommending a project plan.

Colour selection matters for vinyl. Heat absorption and product requirements can limit which shades are appropriate. Cleaning, panel condition and a compatible coating system help create a coordinated finish without overlooking the needs of the siding.
prepare: Clean the panels, remove contamination and assess damage or movement before applying a compatible system.
apply: Use a vinyl-suitable coating and approved colour choice, maintaining even coverage without restricting panel movement.
condition: Cracks, loose panels, staining and distortion should be reviewed before painting is considered.
material: Vinyl expands and contracts. We consider product compatibility, movement and colour limitations for your siding.
goals: Bring colour ideas and tell us whether your priority is a subtle refresh or a more noticeable change.
tip: Ask about colour suitability before committing to a darker shade.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your vinyl siding with the rest of the property.

title: Brick Painting
heading: A Fresh Finish for Your Brick Exterior.
intro: Transform the appearance of your brick facade with a carefully assessed painting plan. Surface condition, moisture and the right coating system guide our approach to a clean, coordinated exterior.
explain: A New Look That Starts with the Masonry.
paragraphs: Painted brick can create a fresh, unified look for your property while preserving the texture of the masonry. It is a lasting change to the surface, so we take time to discuss the appearance and maintenance considerations before starting.

We assess brick and mortar condition, moisture concerns and any existing coating. Cleaning, repairs and compatible products matter more than simply choosing a colour. Areas with unresolved dampness or deteriorating masonry need attention before painting.
prepare: Clean the masonry, assess mortar and surface condition, and identify moisture or repair needs before coating.
apply: Apply a coating system suited to the assessed brick, working into the texture and joints for consistent coverage.
condition: Cracked mortar, damaged brick, moisture and powdery deposits can affect the suitability of a painted finish.
material: Brick and mortar absorb moisture differently from siding. We consider the masonry and the coating requirements together.
goals: Discuss the desired colour, retained texture and long-term maintenance before making a permanent appearance change.
tip: Let us know about water staining, damp areas or previous masonry repairs.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your brick exteriors with the rest of the property.

title: Exterior Stucco Painting
heading: Refresh the Texture. Renew the Exterior.
intro: Restore a clean, coordinated appearance to your stucco exterior with careful assessment, preparation and painting. We work around the texture and condition of the surface to recommend a suitable finish.
explain: A Textured Surface Needs a Thoughtful Finish.
paragraphs: Stucco has a distinctive texture that can collect dirt and show weathering over time. Painting can refresh its colour and appearance while retaining the character of the finish.

The condition of the stucco is part of the painting plan. We look for cracks, loose material and moisture concerns, then discuss repairs and coating requirements. The preparation and application must reach the texture without treating damaged areas as a cosmetic issue alone.
prepare: Clean the texture, assess cracks and loose areas, and arrange suitable repairs before the coating is applied.
apply: Work the selected coating into the stucco texture using methods suited to the surface and product.
condition: Cracks, loose finish, stains and moisture concerns help determine the preparation and repair scope.
material: Different stucco systems and existing finishes can require different products. We assess what is on your property.
goals: Tell us whether you want to retain the current colour or coordinate a new shade with windows, doors and trim.
tip: Highlight recurring cracks or damp patches rather than covering them without assessment.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your stucco surfaces with the rest of the property.

title: Wood Siding Painting
heading: A Beautiful Finish for a Natural Exterior.
intro: Refresh your wood siding with careful preparation and a finish chosen for its condition. We help create a clean, coordinated appearance while giving the material the attention it needs.
explain: Respect the Wood Beneath the Colour.
paragraphs: Wood siding gives a property warmth and character, but exposure can wear down its finish. Painting can refresh the exterior when the boards and existing coating are properly assessed and prepared.

We examine peeling paint, weathered areas, joints and signs of damaged wood before planning the coating work. Cleaning, repairs and preparation create the foundation for an even finish; paint cannot resolve decay or ongoing moisture problems by itself.
prepare: Clean the boards, remove failing paint, prepare sound edges and discuss damaged wood or moisture concerns.
apply: Apply the selected exterior system with attention to the grain, edges and joints for an even finish.
condition: Peeling, exposed grain, soft areas and split boards can change the repair and preparation requirements.
material: Wood condition, previous coatings and exposure guide the finish choice and application plan.
goals: Consider the colour of the siding alongside natural features, porch details and existing exterior trim.
tip: Tell us about areas that stay damp or repeatedly lose their paint.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your wood siding with the rest of the property.

title: Eavestrough & Fascia Painting
heading: Bring Your Roofline Details Together.
intro: Refresh eavestroughs, fascia and related exterior details with a coordinated colour and finish. We assess the materials, access and condition to plan careful painting around your roofline.
explain: Small Exterior Details Make a Clear Difference.
paragraphs: A freshly painted roofline can help tie siding, trim and gutters into one consistent exterior. Eavestrough and fascia painting is a focused way to update details that are often overlooked in a larger colour scheme.

These areas can include different materials and working heights. We review peeling finishes, exposed surfaces, drainage issues and access before painting. Leaks, loose gutters or deteriorated fascia should be addressed as maintenance needs rather than hidden beneath a coating.
prepare: Clean exterior faces, assess failing coatings and material condition, and plan safe access and protection.
apply: Apply suitable finishes to each roofline material, keeping edges coordinated and drainage components functional.
condition: Peeling paint, loose components, water staining and deteriorated fascia affect the project scope.
material: Metal eavestroughs, wood fascia and other trim may require separate preparation and coating choices.
goals: Choose a roofline colour that complements your siding, roof and window trim without overlooking maintenance.
tip: Point out leaks or loose sections so they can be considered before painting.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your eavestroughs and fascia with the rest of the property.

title: Exterior Window & Door Painting
heading: A Fresh Welcome Starts at the Details.
intro: Update exterior doors and window details with a clean, coordinated finish. Careful preparation and precise application help refresh the features that frame your home’s first impression.
explain: A Focused Upgrade for Your Entry and Exterior Frames.
paragraphs: Painted doors and exterior window frames can change how your property looks without a full facade update. From a new front-door colour to coordinated trim, the right finish can bring the exterior together.

We assess the existing coating, frame material and access before planning the work. Hardware, glass, seals and moving parts need careful protection. Suitable products and detailed application help create clean edges while preserving the function of each feature.
prepare: Clean and prepare the paintable surfaces, protect glass and hardware, and assess repairs or failing coatings.
apply: Apply suitable finishes with careful attention to panels, edges and frames while protecting seals and moving parts.
condition: Peeling finishes, damaged frames and sticking doors should be identified before coating work begins.
material: Wood, metal and other frame materials have different requirements; not every component is intended to be painted.
goals: Consider whether the door should be a feature colour or match the surrounding window and facade details.
tip: Tell us which doors must remain accessible and flag any operational problems.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your exterior windows and doors with the rest of the property.

explain: An Exterior That Supports a Positive First Impression.
paragraphs: A well-maintained commercial exterior helps present your business or property clearly to customers, tenants and visitors. Painting can refresh a tired facade and coordinate the building’s visible features.

Commercial projects need preparation around building use as well as surface condition. We discuss access, public areas, working hours and protection requirements, then recommend a suitable approach for the materials and project scope. Scheduling and coordination are agreed for the individual property.
prepare: Assess the facade, clean and prepare surfaces, and plan protection around entrances and occupied areas.
apply: Apply suitable coatings to the agreed scope, coordinating access and work zones with the property contact.
condition: Weathering, loose finishes, damaged surfaces and previous repairs help define the work required.
material: Commercial facades may combine masonry, metal, siding and trim. Each area is assessed for an appropriate system.
goals: Share your appearance priorities, building-use needs and preferred schedule so the scope can be coordinated.
tip: Identify occupied entrances, tenant needs and any site access restrictions early.
benefits: Coordinate the look of your commercial exteriors with the rest of the property.
